topics.description: The fatal shooting of Alex Pretti by federal agents has sparked widespread outrage and calls for investigation. The incident has raised concerns about police brutality and the use of force by federal agents.
topics.reason: Public outcry and demands for justice

topics.description: The federal investigation into Frank Carone, adviser to Eric Adams, has raised questions about the use of federal power and the potential for abuse. The investigation has also sparked concerns about the lack of transparency and accountability in federal investigations.
topics.reason: Concerns about federal overreach and abuse of power
